create.title: New User
create.name: Name
create.taken: This name is already in use.
create.passwordHint: Optional. Without a password, signing in takes one click.
create.copyHint: Reuses the permissions and preferences of an existing account.

profile.name: Name
profile.avatarHint: Choose it in the server’s web interface.

password.label: Password
password.none: No password: signing in takes one click.
password.title: Password
password.clearLead: {name} will be able to sign in without a password.

connect.label: Emby Connect
connect.hint: Link an Emby Connect account to sign in from outside without an address.

delete.label: Delete User
delete.hint: The account, its preferences and its watch history are erased from the server.
delete.self: You can’t delete your own account.
delete.lastAdmin: This is the last active administrator: it can’t be deleted.
delete.title: Delete this user?
delete.lead: The account {name}, its preferences and its watch history will be permanently deleted.

policy.guarded: This account must stay an active administrator.
policy.selfLocked: You can’t remove your own administrator rights.
policy.lastAdmin: This is the server’s last active administrator.

IsAdministrator.label: Administrator
IsAdministrator.desc: Manages the server, the libraries and the other accounts.

IsDisabled.label: Account Disabled
IsDisabled.desc: The user can no longer sign in.

IsHidden.label: Hidden on Sign-In Screen
IsHidden.desc: The name must be typed to sign in.

IsHiddenRemotely.label: Hidden Outside the Local Network
IsHiddenRemotely.desc: Shows on the sign-in screen only at home.

IsHiddenFromUnusedDevices.label: Hidden on New Devices
IsHiddenFromUnusedDevices.desc: Shows only on devices where the user has already signed in.

EnableRemoteAccess.label: Access from Outside
EnableRemoteAccess.desc: Allows signing in from outside the local network.

RemoteClientBitrateLimit.label: Maximum Remote Bitrate
RemoteClientBitrateLimit.desc: Above it, video is converted for connections outside the local network.

EnableAudioPlaybackTranscoding.label: Audio Transcoding
EnableAudioPlaybackTranscoding.desc: Lets the server transcode audio during playback.

EnableVideoPlaybackTranscoding.label: Video Transcoding
EnableVideoPlaybackTranscoding.desc: Lets the server transcode video during playback.

EnablePlaybackRemuxing.label: Remuxing
EnablePlaybackRemuxing.desc: Repackages the video without transcoding it when the device needs it.

ForceRemoteSourceTranscoding.label: Always Transcode Remote Sources
ForceRemoteSourceTranscoding.desc: For media the server itself plays from the internet.

EnableContentDownloading.label: Downloads
EnableContentDownloading.desc: Allows downloading media to the device.

EnableSyncTranscoding.label: Transcoding for Sync
EnableSyncTranscoding.desc: Allows offline copies converted by the server.

EnableMediaConversion.label: Media Conversion
EnableMediaConversion.desc: Allows creating converted versions on the server.

SyncPlayAccess.label: Watch Together
SyncPlayAccess.desc: Access to SyncPlay, synchronised group playback.

EnableAllFolders.label: All Libraries
EnableAllFolders.desc: Turn off to choose the visible libraries.

EnableAllChannels.label: All Channels
EnableAllChannels.desc: Turn off to choose the visible channels.

EnableAllDevices.label: All Devices
EnableAllDevices.desc: Turn off to allow sign-in from some devices only.

MaxParentalRating.label: Maximum Rating
MaxParentalRating.desc: Content rated above it is hidden.

BlockedTags.label: Blocked Tags
BlockedTags.desc: Content with these tags is hidden.

AllowedTags.label: Allowed Tags
AllowedTags.desc: When the list is not empty, only this content is visible.

EnableContentDeletion.label: Delete in All Libraries
EnableContentDeletion.desc: Turn off to choose the libraries where deletion is allowed.

SimultaneousStreamLimit.label: Simultaneous Streams
SimultaneousStreamLimit.desc: Maximum number of streams at once. 0: unlimited.

MaxActiveSessions.label: Simultaneous Sessions
MaxActiveSessions.desc: Maximum number of open sessions at once. 0: unlimited.

LoginAttemptsBeforeLockout.label: Attempts Before Lockout
LoginAttemptsBeforeLockout.desc: Failed sign-ins before the account is disabled. 0: default (3), -1: never.

EnableRemoteControlOfOtherUsers.label: Control Other Users
EnableRemoteControlOfOtherUsers.desc: Drive playback on other users’ devices.

EnableSharedDeviceControl.label: Control Shared Devices
EnableSharedDeviceControl.desc: Drive DLNA players and shared devices.

EnableUserPreferenceAccess.label: Edit Own Preferences
EnableUserPreferenceAccess.desc: Access to one’s own profile settings.

EnableCollectionManagement.label: Manage Collections
EnableCollectionManagement.desc: Create collections and add items to them.

AllowSharingPersonalItems.label: Share Personal Items
AllowSharingPersonalItems.desc: Share playlists and collections with other users.

AllowCameraUpload.label: Camera Upload
AllowCameraUpload.desc: Upload photos from mobile devices to the server.

policy.disableAdmin: Jellyfin won’t disable an administrator: remove that role first.

IncludeTags.label: Allowed Tags
IncludeTags.desc: When the list is not empty, only content with these tags is visible.

devices.count: {n, plural, =0 {No devices} one {# device} other {# devices}}
devices.foot: Deleting a device signs it out: it will have to sign in again with a password.
devices.customNameHint: Leave empty to use the device’s own name.
devices.deleteLead: {name} will be signed out and will have to sign in again.
devices.ownHint: Wicaby uses this device to connect to the server.

schedule.label: Access Schedule
schedule.none: No schedule: the user can sign in at any time.
schedule.desc: The user can only sign in during these times.
